from datetime import date, timedelta

def current_streak(days, today=None):
    """Count the run of done days ending today or yesterday."""
    today = today or date.today()
    done = set(days)
    if today not in done:  # still alive until midnight
        today -= timedelta(days=1)
    n = 0
    while today in done:
        n += 1
        today -= timedelta(days=1)
    return n

print(current_streak([date(2026, 11, 7), date(2026, 11, 8)]))

SELECT title, status, due
FROM tasks
WHERE status = :s AND due LIKE '2026-11-%'
ORDER BY created DESC
LIMIT 50
